{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Ground| type2=Steel| trainername=Clay| pokemonname=Excadrill| jtrainername=ヤーコン| jpokemonname=ドリュウズ| tmtrainername=Yakon| tmpokemonname=Doryuzu| image=[[File:Clay Excadrill.png|220px]]| caption=Clay's Excadrill| location=Unknown| gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in the games}}| ability={{a|Sand Rush}}{{tt|*|confirmed in the games and Pokémon Adventures only}}| epnum=BW061| epname=Battling the King of the Mines!| prevonum=530| noevo=incap| current=[[Party|With Clay]]| java1=[[Kensuke Satō]]| enva1=[[Tom Wayland]]| }} '''Clay's Excadrill''' (Japanese: '''ヤーコンのドリュウズ''' ''Yakon's Doryuzu'') is [[Clay]]'s main {{pkmn|battle|battling}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== [[File:Ash Boldore Sturdy.png|thumb|250px|Excadrill battling Boldore]] Sometime prior to the start of the series, Excadrill helped Clay with digging out and expanding the mine he was working on. It would eventually become the current form of the [[Driftveil Gym]]. It debuted in ''[[BW061|Battling the King of the Mines!]]'', where it was Clay's final Pokémon in his [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}}. It first fought [[Ash's Snivy]] and was able to easily block all of Snivy's attacks with Rapid Spin before knocking her out with Horn Drill. Excadrill next fought [[Ash's Roggenrola]]. Roggenrola created a {{weather|Sandstorm}}, but this did no visible damage to Excadrill, as it is a {{2t|Ground|Steel}} Pokémon. Excadrill then used Drill Run underground, hitting Roggenrola multiple times by going in and out of the ground. Immediately after, Excadrill used its [[one-hit knockout move]] Horn Drill on Roggenrola, and while it sustained damage, Roggenrola endured it with its {{a|Sturdy}} [[Ability]]. It then evolved into a {{p|Boldore}}. Excadrill used Horn Drill again but was blocked by Sturdy once more, then it went for another Drill Run. Boldore caught this and used its red stones to communicate with Ash about its new move, Rock Blast. Using Rock Blast, Boldore was able to deal damage to Excadrill and knock it back. It then communicated its other new move Rock Smash, which it immediately used. Excadrill used Rock Smash as well, and whilst both were powerful, Boldore's Rock Smash overpowered Excadrill's, defeating the Subterrene Pokémon and winning Ash the {{badge|Quake}}. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'' while Ash was recalling the [[Gym Leader]]s he faced in his [[Unova]] journey. ====Personality and characteristics==== Excadrill is a resilient and hardworking Pokémon and much like its Trainer, values direct confrontation. Its high defense and Rapid Spin make it a formidable battler. Having been with Clay since childhood, Excadrill shares a deep and loyal bond with him. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ground|steel|Clay Excadrill {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Rapid Spin thrust|1=Horn Drill|2=Drill Run|3=Rock Smash}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Rapid Spin|1=Horn Drill|2=Drill Run|3=Rock Smash}}}} {{anmov|normal|Rapid Spin|BW061|Battling the King of the Mines!}} {{anmov|normal|Horn Drill|BW061|Battling the King of the Mines!}} {{anmov|ground|Drill Run|BW061|Battling the King of the Mines!}} {{anmov|fighting|Rock Smash|BW061|Battling the King of the Mines!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ===''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''=== Excadrill was mentioned in ''[[HZ117|Ult-imate Training]]'' by [[Lacey]] as one of the main motivations for her training her own Excadrill. ===Pokémon Generations=== [[File:Clay Excadrill PG.png|thumb|250px|Excadrill in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] Excadrill appeared in ''[[PG13|The Uprising]]'', where it was seen battling the Pokémon belonging to some {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ground|steel|Clay Excadrill Drill Run PG.png|Using Drill Run}} {{anmov|ground|Drill Run|PG13|The Uprising}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ===GOTCHA!=== Clay's Excadrill briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== Excadrill has appeared as Clay's signature Pokémon in every game he has appeared in. ==={{game|Black and White|s}}=== {{Pokémon |caption='''Gym battle''' |gen=5 |ndex=0530 |pokemon=Excadrill |level=31 |gender=male |type1=Ground|type2=Steel |ability=Sand Rush |move1=Hone Claws|move1type=Dark|move1cat=Status |move2=Slash|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Physical |move3=Rock Slide|move3type=Rock|move3cat=Physical |move4=Bulldoze|move4type=Ground|move4cat=Physical }} ==={{B2W2}}=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''Gym battle

[[Type Expert Tournament|Type Expert]]/[[World Leaders Tournament]]''' |gen=5 |ndex=0530 |pokemon=Excadrill |level=50 |gender=both |type1=Ground|type2=Steel |ability=Sand Rush|ability2=Sand Force |held=Focus Sash |move1=Drill Run|move1type=Ground|move1cat=Physical |move2=Rock Slide|move2type=Rock|move2cat=Physical |move3=Submission|move3type=Fighting|move3cat=Physical |move4=Swords Dance|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Status }} {{Pokémon/Grid/end}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Clay Excadrill Adventures.png|250px|thumb|Excadrill in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===== Excadrill first appeared ''[[PS465|Lights, Camera...Action!]]'' digging up a mysterious stone at the [[Desert Resort]]. It was seen protecting the stone alongside Clay's other Pokémon in ''[[PS474|Defeating Stoutland]]''. In ''[[PS492|Mine Mayhem]]'', Excadrill was used in {{adv|Black}}'s Gym battle against Clay, battling against {{adv|Black}}'s {{p|Tirtouga}}, [[Costa]]. Excadrill attempted to hit Costa with a supereffective {{m|Drill Run}}, but the attack did little damage. It was later sent out to battle Black's {{p|Pignite}}, [[Bo|Nite]]. Having permission to wreak havoc on the Gym, Excadrill used a strategy where it {{m|Dig|dug}} into the ground in order to hide where it was before popping back up and attacking. Deciding it was okay to do the same, Black had Nite attack every hole that was made in order to find where Excadrill was. Nite soon found Excadrill and crashed into it, causing a rock to break the generator giving the mine light. Upon checking what happened, it was shown that Excadrill and Nite were both defeated. In ''[[PS495|The Battle Within]]'', Excadrill battled alongside the other Gym Leaders against the [[Shadow Triad]] to protect the [[Dark Stone]]. During the battle, it was attacked by their {{p|Lilligant}}'s {{m|Mega Drain}}. The group is eventually defeated when {{adv|Forces of nature|Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus}} show up. In ''[[PS522|Homecoming]]'', Excadrill fought alongside the other Gym Leaders' Pokémon against the [[Seven Sages]] at the {{un|Pokémon League}}. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== In ''[[PS546|Giant Chasm]]'', Excadrill was used in [[Opelucid City]] to help free people from their homes that were frozen by {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}}. ====Personality and characteristics==== Excadrill was relied on more often than Clay's other Pokémon as it was involved in the battle with the Seven Sages. It is powerful and fast, able to deal damage quickly. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ground|steel|Clay Excadrill {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Drill Run|1=Dig}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Drill Run|1=Dig}}}} {{anmov|ground|Dig|PS493|Underground Showdown}} {{anmov|ground|Drill Run|PS522|Homecoming}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Clay Excadrill PMBW.png|thumb|220px|Excadrill in Pocket Monsters BW]] Excadrill appears in {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}}. {{-}} ==In the TCG== Excadrill is featured in the TCG as one of Clay's Pokémon. {{cardlist/header|Clay's Excadrill|Fighting|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Cosmic Eclipse|Excadrill|115}}|type=Fighting|enset=Cosmic Eclipse|enrarity=Rare Secret|ennum=246/236|jpset=Dream League|jprarity=CHR|jpnum=059/049}} {{cardlist/footer|Fighting}} ==Trivia== * Excadrill is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Drill Run}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Excadrill}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Gym Leaders' Pokémon|Excadrill]] [[Category:Black and White characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Generations characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[es:Excadrill de Clay/Yakón]] [[it:Excadrill di Rafan]]
